units.previous_finding: Naturalness/semantic framing: 'Kursas suskirstytas į modulių sąrašą' unnaturally frames the course as divided into a list rather than organized into modules; revise idiomatically while preserving access to the module list, link binding, and the Pažintis su Go glossary decision.

Lithuanian syntax/location relationship: 'Programoms, kurias galima vykdyti Go Playground' does not naturally express execution within the Go Playground environment and can read as if Go Playground were the object; revise to make the environment relationship explicit while preserving the Go Playground identity.

Technical semantic error: 'Jei key yra m, ok yra true.' loses the source membership/existence relation 'If key is in m, ok is true' and can mean key is m; revise to state that key exists/is present in map m while preserving key, m, ok, true, and false.

Navigation semantics/naturalness: 'tęsti kitą pamoką' can imply continuing another already-started lesson rather than proceeding to the next lesson. Revise to express continuing to/entering the next lesson, preserving the link target, pamoka terminology, and page structure.

Technical terminology scope: the title translates 'pointer indirection' as 'rodyklių dereferencijavimas', narrowing the concept to dereference even though this page also explains automatic address-taking such as v.Scale(5) -> (&v).Scale(5). Revise the title to a broader pointer-indirection concept and do not conflate it with dereference.

Technical terminology scope: 'pointer indirection (2)' is again rendered as 'rodyklių dereferencijavimas (2)', incorrectly equating the broader pointer-indirection concept with dereference. Keep this title consistent with the preceding page using a broader accurate term, preserving '(2)'.

Word order/technical naturalness: 'begalinį simbolio ASCII srautą' with a following 'A' makes the modifier relation unclear. Revise so it naturally and explicitly means an infinite stream consisting of the ASCII character 'A', preserving Reader and the literal 'A' identity.

Navigation semantics/naturalness: 'tęsti kitą pamoką' does not naturally express 'continue with the next lesson'. Revise to clearly express proceeding to/entering the next lesson while preserving the link target and terminology.

Navigation semantics/naturalness: 'tęsti kitą pamoką' does not naturally express continuing into the next lesson. Revise to an idiomatic next-lesson navigation expression while preserving link binding and page structure.

Link-label naturalness: 'Pirmos klasės funkcijos Go' does not clearly express source 'First Class Functions in Go' and lacks a natural grammatical relation to the Go language. Revise the link label to clearly mean first-class functions in Go, preserving Go and the original link target.
